name: NPJ Suggest (open reader feedback → article folder)

nodes.name: Suggest Webhook
nodes.notes:
OPEN READER FEEDBACK (write-only → GitHub)
POST /webhook/site/suggest-npj
Authorization: Bearer <matrix token>  (ANY whoami-verified user — no role needed)
Body: { filename:'articles/<slug>/<stamp>-eva-<hash>.jsonl', contentRaw, message? }
contentRaw is exactly one EVA event line. The webhook re-stamps actor/author
from the verified token, then CREATES the file in clovenbradshaw-ctrl/npj (main).
It can only ever create *-eva-*.jsonl inside articles/<slug>/ — never the
genesis, a REC/INS, or any other path — so it cannot change a published word.
Merging a suggestion stays on the gated publish webhook (it commits a REC).

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ ok: false, error: $json.reason || 'rejected', user: $json.user_id || null, filename: $json.filename || null }) }}
